name: devices-scoped
description: Device catalog, registration and rename under OSI_SCOPED_ACCESS=1: the lifecycle list filter (unclaimed-and-unzoned rows hidden, foreign-owned and zone-assigned rows visible), the scoped claim router's zone_id handling and role gate, and the scoped rename device-access gate (routes #10-#12, scoped arm).

steps.why: Scoped reads are account-wide with a lifecycle filter: A1 (owned), A2 (zone-assigned, unclaimed) and A4 (foreign-owned) are listed; A3 (no owner, no zone) is hidden.

The scoped router maps every 404 to 'Device not found', including a missing zone.
